messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy failed for release/flux-rls v3 -> multiple pods CrashLoopBackOff in namespace svc-inference. Started at 1744501111. Automatic rollout paused. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-failure

aj (oncall): paging. i'm on it. which svc / deployment? any obvious error in pods?

chris (platform): seeing initContainer 'fetch-secrets' crash repeatedly with 403 from vault. attaching describe snippet:

```
Name:         inference-api-rls-5f7d9
Namespace:    svc-inference
Containers:
  inference:
    State:          Waiting
    Reason:         CrashLoopBackOff
Init Containers:
  fetch-secrets:
    State:          Terminated
    Reason:         Error
    Exit Code:      1
    Last Exit:      Tue Mar 11 16:45:10 UTC 2025
Events:
  Warning  Failed     30s   kubelet  Error: failed to start container \"fetch-secrets\": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = 403 vault kv get \"secret/prod/inference\"
```

chris (platform): looks like the init pulled a specific secret path that doesn't exist in the new rollout configs. suspect template name changed in the helm chart.

sara (sre): HPA reacted to failed pods, started scaling other replicas, then node pressure caused eviction churn. Customer metrics: inference-prod-usw: ~20% 5xx spike since rollout started. CS flagged 2 enterprise tenants reporting 503s.

mira (cs): i have customer A on the line and escalating. they're seeing timeouts for batch jobs, asking for ETA. i've told them we're investigating and will update in 15.

aj (oncall): ok immediate mitigation options: 1) disable feature flag for rollout (fastest), 2) rollback deployment to previous revision, 3) patch initContainer to not fail (riskier). Recommendation: disable flag + rollback. @chris can you flip flag?

chris (platform): preparing flag disable. using internal flags API. executing now:

```
# disable feature via internal flag service
curl -s -X POST https://flags.internal/api/flags/rls-new-rewrite/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"actor":"deploy-rollback","reason":"initContainer 403 causing crashloop"}'
```

chris (platform): :white_check_mark: flag disabled, confirmed new requests go to stable path (logs show old codepath).

aj (oncall): proceeding with rollback as well: `kubectl -n svc-inference rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=2`

ops-bot: Rollout undo triggered by aj (oncall) at 1744501300. Monitoring pods...

chris (platform): pods now cycling. 2/5 ready -> 5/5 ready within 3m. InitContainers no longer hit vault path.

sara (sre): metrics recovering. 5xx back down to baseline within 5m of flag disable + rollback. No data loss. Still validating HPA stabilization.

mira (cs): updated the affected customers, they acknowledged the update and appreciate quick mitigation. I'll follow up with a formal status email.

incidents-bot: Created INC-2025-0421 for this event. Severity: P2. Impact: partial customer-facing 5xx for inference endpoints in us-west. Linked runbook and assigned to eng-oncall for RCA.

aj (oncall): Handoff: i'll capture timeline and start RCA doc. Assigning to @chris and @sara for root cause and postmortem. Next steps: 1) verify helm chart templating for secret path names, 2) add guard in initContainer to fail-open with warning for missing dev-only secrets, 3) add pre-rollout smoke test that validates secret paths.

chris (platform): noted. i'll open a PR for chart fix and smoke test. Also adding a new gating job to run `kubectl apply --dry-run=server` + `kubectl exec` style smoke probe before promoting to prod.

sara (sre): adding HPA policy tweak to avoid immediate large scale-up during rollout failures (cooldown). Will coordinate with chris on safe defaults.

aj (oncall): thanks team. putting this into the oncall queue for postmortem tomorrow. Handoff to night oncall in 30m. Closing live thread. :lock_with_ink_pen:
